# STD-APP-UI-001: Frontend Styling Standards

**Standards Metadata**

```yaml
standard_id: 'STD-APP-UI-001'
standard_name: 'Frontend Styling Standards'
standard_type: 'application'
category: 'application'
version: '1.0.0'
status: 'active'
compliance_level: 'mandatory'
tags: ['application', 'frontend', 'styling', 'tailwind', 'css', 'responsive', 'accessibility', 'wcag', 'mandatory']
```

---

> This document defines mandatory standards for Tailwind CSS usage conventions, class organization, responsive breakpoints, co-location rules, prohibition of CSS-in-JS in new work, and WCAG 2.2 contrast compliance at the component level. All React-based frontend applications and micro-frontend remote modules must comply with these standards.

---

[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#10-overview]

## 1.0 Overview

This standard establishes mandatory rules for frontend styling in all React-based applications at Gainwell Technologies. It is the enforcement companion to [GUID-APP-UI-001](../../../strategy/guidance/application/design-tokens/GUID-APP-UI-001-design-tokens-theming-guidance.md) (design token taxonomy and theming strategy) and directly implements the styling requirements of [STD-APP-ACC-001](../accessibility/STD-APP-ACC-001-accessibility.md) (WCAG 2.2 AA).

**The enterprise styling stack is Tailwind CSS** as mandated by [ADR-APP-003](../../../decisions/application/ADR-APP-003-ui-component-system-selection.md). No alternative CSS framework or CSS-in-JS library is permitted in new work.

---

[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#21-in-scope]

### 2.1 In Scope

- All new React component development
- All Next.js shell applications and remote module applications using the enterprise stack (ADR-APP-002, ADR-APP-003)
- Shadcn/UI components copied into application codebases
- Custom components that extend beyond Shadcn/UI primitives

[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#22-out-of-scope]

### 2.2 Out of Scope

- Legacy ASP.NET Razor Pages applications (governed by separate standards until migration per PTN-APP-MFE-013)
- Third-party embedded UI components (e.g., Kendo UI for React when used for complex grid/chart per ADR-APP-003) — Kendo's `.k-*` CSS class system within the Kendo component boundary is exempt from the Tailwind-only requirement. Qualifying criteria, the two approved patterns (greenfield and drop-in), and mandatory Tailwind preflight mitigation when Kendo coexists in a module are defined in [GUID-APP-TEC-003](../../../strategy/guidance/application/ui-component-system/GUID-APP-TEC-003-ui-component-system-guidance.md).
- Marketing websites not built on the enterprise React stack
page_texts.8:
[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#23-compliance-level]

### 2.3 Compliance Level

**Mandatory** — All items in this standard marked **MUST** are required. Items marked **SHOULD** are strongly recommended. Items marked **MAY** are permitted but not required.

Violations of mandatory requirements are flagged at the architecture review gate (ADR-GOV-001) and in CI linting.

[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#std-ui-002-no-inline-styles-for-layout]

#### STD-UI-002: No Inline Styles for Layout

**MUST NOT** use inline `style` attributes for layout, spacing, typography, or color properties that can be expressed as Tailwind classes.

```tsx
// ✅ COMPLIANT
<button className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] px-4 py-2">Submit</button>

// ❌ NON-COMPLIANT — inline style for layout
<button style={{ minHeight: '44px', minWidth: '44px', padding: '8px 16px' }}>Submit</button>
```

**Exception**: Inline styles are permitted for dynamic values that cannot be expressed as static Tailwind classes (e.g., a width value derived from a JavaScript calculation).

```tsx
// ✅ PERMITTED EXCEPTION — dynamic value not expressible as a static Tailwind class
<div style={{ width: `${progress}%` }} className="h-2 rounded-full bg-primary" />
```
page_texts.15:
[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#std-ui-004-class-group-ordering]

#### STD-UI-004: Class Group Ordering

**MUST** order Tailwind classes in the following canonical group sequence. Use Prettier with `prettier-plugin-tailwindcss` (the official Tailwind class sorter) to enforce this automatically:

```
1. Layout (display, position, float, clear, visibility)
2. Box model (sizing: w, h, max-w, min-h, overflow)
3. Flexbox / Grid (flex, grid, gap, place, justify, items, self)
4. Spacing (p, m — padding before margin)
5. Typography (text-size, font, leading, tracking, whitespace)
6. Color / Background (bg, text, border, ring color)
7. Borders (rounded, border-width, outline)
8. Effects (shadow, opacity, blur, backdrop)
9. Transitions / Animation
10. Pseudo-class / Responsive variants (hover:, focus:, sm:, md:, lg:)
```

```bash
# Install the Tailwind Prettier plugin
npm install --save-dev prettier prettier-plugin-tailwindcss

# .prettierrc.json
{
  "plugins": ["prettier-plugin-tailwindcss"]
}
```

[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#std-ui-005-responsive-variant-ordering] #### STD-UI-005: Responsive Variant Ordering **MUST** place responsive variants in ascending breakpoint order: `sm:` before `md:` before `lg:` before `xl:` before `2xl:`. ```tsx // ✅ COMPLIANT — ascending breakpoint order
...
// ❌ NON-COMPLIANT — out of order
...
```
page_texts.18:
[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#std-ui-006-use-semantic-token-classes]

#### STD-UI-006: Use Semantic Token Classes

**MUST** use Tailwind semantic token classes for all color, background, and border styling. Do not use Tailwind's raw palette classes (e.g., `blue-600`) for colors that the design system controls.

```tsx
// ✅ COMPLIANT — semantic tokens
<button className="bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90">Submit</button>

// ❌ NON-COMPLIANT — raw Tailwind palette bypasses design system
<button className="bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700">Submit</button>
```

**Permitted exceptions for raw palette classes**:

- `gray-*` / `neutral-*` for one-off separators or decorative elements not tied to brand color
- Chart / data visualization colors when the chart token set does not cover the required series

[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#41-breakpoint-definitions]

### 4.1 Breakpoint Definitions

The enterprise breakpoint system **MUST** use the Tailwind CSS default breakpoints. No custom breakpoints are added to `tailwind.config.ts` without Enterprise Architecture Practice approval.

| Breakpoint | Prefix | Min Width | Device Context                          |
| ---------- | ------ | --------- | --------------------------------------- |
| (default)  | —      | 0px       | Mobile phones (portrait)                |
| Small      | `sm:`  | 640px     | Mobile phones (landscape) / small tablets |
| Medium     | `md:`  | 768px     | Tablets                                 |
| Large      | `lg:`  | 1024px    | Laptops / small desktops                |
| Extra-large| `xl:`  | 1280px    | Desktop workstations                    |
| 2XL        | `2xl:` | 1536px    | Large / wide monitors                   |

[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#std-ui-009-no-custom-max-width-breakpoints]

#### STD-UI-009: No Custom max-width Breakpoints

**MUST NOT** use CSS `max-width` media queries for responsive behavior. Tailwind's `sm:`, `md:`, `lg:` etc. are min-width only; this is the correct constraint.

page_texts.28:
[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#std-ui-010-styles-co-located-with-components]

#### STD-UI-010: Styles Co-located with Components

**MUST** co-locate all component styles within the component file via Tailwind utility classes. A component's visual definition lives in the same file as its markup and behavior.

```
src/
  components/
    ui/
      button.tsx          ← styling via className="" in this file
      card.tsx            ← styling via className="" in this file
    claims/
      ClaimStatusBadge.tsx ← component + styles in one file
```

[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#std-ui-014-minimum-contrast-ratios]

#### STD-UI-014: Minimum Contrast Ratios

**MUST** meet the following WCAG 2.2 contrast ratios at the component level for all text and interactive elements:

| Content Type                         | Minimum Ratio | WCAG Criterion  |
| ------------------------------------ | ------------- | --------------- |
| Normal text (< 18pt / < 14pt bold)   | 4.5:1         | 1.4.3 AA        |
| Large text (≥ 18pt / ≥ 14pt bold)   | 3:1           | 1.4.3 AA        |
| UI component states (borders, icons) | 3:1           | 1.4.11 AA       |
| Focused element outline              | 3:1 (against adjacent) | 2.4.11 AA |

**These ratios apply in both light mode and dark mode.**
page_texts.37: [standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#std-ui-015-no-color-as-the-sole-differentiator] #### STD-UI-015: No Color as the Sole Differentiator **MUST NOT** use color as the sole means of conveying information. Status indicators, error states, and data categories must use additional cues (icon, text, pattern, or label). ```tsx // ❌ NON-COMPLIANT — color only Active // ✅ COMPLIANT — color + icon + text label Active ```
page_texts.39:
[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#std-ui-016-automated-contrast-testing-in-ci]

#### STD-UI-016: Automated Contrast Testing in CI

**MUST** validate WCAG 1.4.3 contrast compliance in CI using axe-core (per GUID-APP-ACC-001 §5). Color contrast violations **MUST** block the CI pipeline.
page_texts.42:
[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#std-ui-018-minimum-body-text-size]

#### STD-UI-018: Minimum Body Text Size

**MUST** use a minimum body text size of 16px (`text-base`) for all paragraph and body content. Font sizes below 16px **MUST** be limited to captions, helper text, and table cell annotations (`text-sm` = 14px).
page_texts.43:
[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#std-ui-019-line-height-for-readability]

#### STD-UI-019: Line Height for Readability

**MUST** use `leading-normal` (1.5) or greater for paragraph text to satisfy WCAG 1.4.12 (Text Spacing). Do not override line-height to less than 1.5× the font size on body copy.
page_texts.48:
[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#std-ui-022-respect-prefers-reduced-motion] #### STD-UI-022: Respect prefers-reduced-motion **MUST** wrap all CSS animations and transitions in a `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)` query, or use Tailwind's `motion-safe:` variant. ```tsx // ✅ COMPLIANT — motion-safe variant
{children}
// ✅ COMPLIANT — Tailwind's built-in animate- classes use motion-safe
```
page_texts.49:
[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#std-ui-023-no-distracting-animation]

#### STD-UI-023: No Distracting Animation

**MUST NOT** use animations that flash more than 3 times per second (WCAG 2.3.1).

[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#std-ui-025-stylehooks-for-module-specific-surfaces-only]

#### STD-UI-025: `styleHooks` for Module-Specific Surfaces Only

**MUST** declare in `contract.styleHooks` only CSS custom properties for surfaces **not covered** by `core-theme.css` — domain-specific status colours, chart palettes, graph edge colours, data-visualisation tokens, etc. **MUST NOT** declare `styleHooks` entries for tokens already owned by `core-theme.css`.

```json
/* ✅ COMPLIANT — module-specific, not in core-theme.css */
{ "token": "--claims-status-approved",  "kind": "cssVar", "default": "#1cab3b" },
{ "token": "--claims-status-denied",    "kind": "cssVar", "default": "#d7385e" },

/* ❌ NON-COMPLIANT — already in core-theme.css */
{ "token": "--my-module-text-color",    "kind": "cssVar", "default": "#2b3a44" },
{ "token": "--my-module-bg",            "kind": "cssVar", "default": "#ffffff" }
```

[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#111-linting]

### 11.1 Linting

**MUST** configure ESLint with the following plugins for Tailwind CSS compliance:

```bash
npm install --save-dev eslint-plugin-tailwindcss
```

```json
// .eslintrc.json (excerpt)
{
  "extends": ["plugin:tailwindcss/recommended"],
  "rules": {
    "tailwindcss/classnames-order": "warn",
    "tailwindcss/no-arbitrary-value": "warn",
    "tailwindcss/no-contradicting-classname": "error"
  }
}
```
page_texts.56:
[standards/application/styling/STD-APP-UI-001-frontend-styling-standards.md#113-accessibility-testing]

### 11.3 Accessibility Testing

Per GUID-APP-ACC-001, **MUST** run axe-core automated accessibility tests for all components. Contrast violations **MUST** fail CI.
